verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Thoropass publishes an llms.txt at help.thoropass.com (HTTP 200) with a structured, markdown-linked index of the help center. Help articles are also served as .md URLs, giving agents clean, machine-readable docs to point at. Missing for 10: no llms-full.txt or agent-specific guidance evidenced, coverage appears limited to help-center content (no API/developer reference), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.thoropass.com/llms.txt # Thoropass Help Center
